observations: Read-only canaries with an explicit model and closed stdin timed out.
A PTY canary also timed out without model events.
Ignoring user configuration did not produce a model response.
Startup debug output included HTTP 401 from a featured-plugin endpoint: authentication token could not be parsed.
diagnostic_limit: The plugin authentication error is observed; it does not establish the final cause of the model startup hang.
consequence: No profile qualification or product-owned live model execution is claimed. No account credentials were extracted or copied.
private_logs: Raw debug logs are withheld because they can contain account/configuration data.
